Captain King and his crew going up in space and taking adventures on other planets.But have you heard stories of creatures from space coming down to the earth?What do we call people from other planets?Right, aliens.If aliens want to visit the earth, how will they get here?Maybe they will fly in their spaceships, which we call UFOs, 不明飞行物, or flying sources, 飞碟.Do you believe in aliens or UFOs?Let's do a quiz to find out.Insert the two questions and then add your points.How many points have you got, Julia?I've got six points.Wow, you are a total believer, aren't you?Do you think the earth has ever been visited by alien life?I think the earth has been visited by alien life, which is why there are pyramids, stonehenge, and other structures built by ancient civilizations.Some say they were built by aliens, and some say they were built for visiting aliens.Right,一些人认为金字塔和英国的巨石镇有可能是外星人造的,或者为外星人造的。Eric, what about you?I don't believe in aliens because I have seen no proof of them.Yes, we don't see them today, but we have a lot of stories and movies about UFOs and aliens.What movies have you seen about UFOs and aliens either visiting earth or making contact with earthlings?I've seen a lot of movies about UFOs and aliens, such as ET,外星人ET, The Day the Earth Stood Still,地球停转之日,Alien, 异星,Star Trek, 星际迷航,Arrival, 降临,The Bird Box, 蒙上你的眼,etc.How are aliens portrayed?Some aliens are portrayed as ugly and stupid, others are clever and good, and still others are terrifying and evil.几乎所有宇宙人物都具有某种超级能力或特殊能力有些宇宙人物看起来像人物有些像动物或鸭子谢谢Eric你真的喜欢宇宙电影今天我们要读一本宇宙人物和浴室的故事先看看介绍部分什么是我们所谓的观众?我们称之为观众故事是什么?故事是Roswell事件是真实的故事吗?是的,事件意味着事件事件是真的发生的事件尤其是不常见的、重要的、严重的事件发生在哪里?对,1947年在美国首先,我们要关注RoswellRoswell是个人或一个地方?是一个地方Roswell是一个西北纽约城市有很多农场所以,在1947年,世界上发生了什么?1945年发生了什么?当时最强大的国家是什么?这两个国家之间的关系是什么?我知道第二次世界大战在1945年结束刚刚之后,冬战开始了有两个超级力量俄罗斯和美国他们有强烈的强硬兵力这两个国家尽力以赴发展新和提前的武器你真是有知识当时,美国的军事部队在Roswell建立了一个军事部队人们可能在军事部队做什么?他们做了一些军事训练测试航空发展新武器等等现在,你对Roswell的事件有兴趣吗?请打开你的书本转到121号快速走过通道告诉你它主要在说什么还有它的写字你只有1分钟请打开你的书本转到121号快速走过通道告诉你它主要在说什么还有它的写字你只有1分钟快速走过通道告诉你它主要在说什么还有它的写字你只有1分钟快速走过通道告诉你它主要在说什么还有它的写字你只有1分钟快速走过通道告诉你它主要在说什么还有它的写字你只有1分钟快速走过通道告诉你它主要在说什么还有它的写字你只有1分钟快速走过通道告诉你它主要在说什么还有它的写字你只有1分钟快速走过通道告诉你它主要在说什么时间到了,Erik,你觉得怎么样?这篇文章主要告诉我们,Roswell发生了一个偶然的事件。没有人认识有哪一艘宇宙发生了什么。这篇文章是什么样的?看看下一个五个文章。他们有什么共同的?每个文章都是第一个人的故事,他们都被一个人看见。他们被看见。他们的名字和工作都在图线里。所以,这篇文章是在一个面试中的一篇文章中的一份报道。有多少人被看见?但是我们不知道他们的名字和工作。请猜猜,为什么证人A和证人D没有名字?我认为他们可能是居住地区的人,不想把他们的名字交给媒体。他们比较喜欢被看见。他们不愿意透露姓名。有时候,军人会被看见,这会让他们的报道更有信仰和正式,例如Winis E,一名军人叫Melvin Brown。看看Winis C,Major Marcel。是Major的第一名吗?其实不是。请看看评论文章中的一篇文章。你认为Major的名字是什么?这里,Major的名字是军人的军官,少孝。现在,让我们看看证人们如何描述案件。他们描述了他们在哪里,和谁在哪里,他们看见什么,和他们做什么。他们还提供了评论证人们看见什么。我想让你们读得更仔细,我希望让你们读得更仔细,让你们读得更仔细,证人们看见什么。然后,在工作室上完成一份工作。在工作室上完成一份工作。现在,让我们看看我的学生,Julius的答案。证人A和他妻子看见一只亮面的物件在天空上飞得很快。Julius,证人A知道那是什么吗?不,证人A的意思是他不知道那是什么。现在,让我们谈谈证人B。William B covers the bangers and 20 species of fish.William B found some wreckage on his farm the next day.Wreckage means parts of something such as a plane,ship or building that are left after it has been destroyed in an accident,Xanghai.Here is a picture of the wreckage of the spaceship.What was strange about the wreckage?It was made of strange metal with some strange writing on some of the pieces.Good.Then he called the local air base.But why the air base?He might think the wreckage came from a military aircraft.So what was the reply?Major Marcel came and collected it.But he told William Brasso not to talk to anyone else about it.Thank you.Now let's come to Major Marcel's statement.After he collected some of the wreckage, he gave it to another army officer.What was the army's reply?The army said the wreckage came from a weather balloon.What is a weather balloon?What is it used for?A weather balloon is a large strong balloon which is sent high up in the air to collect information about the winds and temperature.It's usually made of latex or synthetic rubber.Did he believe the army?Why or why not?No, he didn't.He said it was a lie, because the matter was something he had never seen before or since.Correct.What about witness D?The kit seemed to give us the most details, not only about the spaceship, but also some strange creatures, all he called aliens.Here are three pictures.Can you choose the right one according to witness D's description of the spaceship and the aliens?And tell us your reasons.It's task two on your worksheet.Eric, what is your answer?I think the second picture is the right one.According to witness D's description, there were three dead aliens lying by the side of the spaceship.There were only two in the first picture.While in the third picture, three dead aliens were lying on the top of the spaceship.Besides, the fourth alien sitting on a rock should be frightened, instead of being excited.Thank you, Eric.You are really a good observer.Let's come to the last witness.What does guard here mean?It is used as a verb here, meaning to protect a person, place or object by staying near them and watching them.Why did he look inside a truck?Because he was curious about what was kept at cold temperatures.Good guess.The truck was refrigerated.A refrigerated truck is usually used for the transportation of food and products that require temperature control.When he looked inside the refrigerated truck, he saw three dead bodies.What did they look like?They had small bodies, big heads and nice friendly faces.Now I have another question for you.Did the five witnesses believe there was really a UFO?I think witness D definitely believed there was really a UFO.He used the word alien and gave it a very detailed description.Witness A must have some doubts about what he saw.He was quite in the middle.Maybe it was something from outer space.But then again, maybe it was not.Witness B found wreckage including some unusual metal with writing on it.It doesn't say what he called the air base, but maybe he thought the pieces were due to a plane crash.Witness C and E were military men.I guess they hadn't believed the UFOs were aliens until they saw the wreckage and the dead bodies.Because they described the metal and the aliens as something unusual, and one of them even disagreed with the conclusion from the army.Good reasoning.But do you believe their stories?Are their accounts reliable?他們說的東西可信嗎?Whose story do you believe?I quite believe what Major Marcel said.As a military officer, he was honest enough to show his doubts and his disagreement with the army.I don't believe what Witness D said.He was just a five-year-old boy.How come he remembered the details so well?It could have been imaginable.Or perhaps he liked to attract public attention.Actually, each witness offers an opinion about what they saw.For example,Witness A said the object went much faster than a plane.I don't think this is a fact that has been proved.He gave his opinion while he was trying to tell the facts.The same goes to Witness B.He thought the metal was stronger than any metal he had.He used the word strange to describe the writing he was giving his opinion to.An opinion may be supported by facts.But different people draw different conclusions or opinions, even if they agree on the same set of facts.That's why it's hard for us to judge whether the witnesses believed in UFOs or not.Now, do you believe aliens really exist?Are you still a total believer or do you become doubtful?I was a total believer of UFOs until I read a story.Now I know that the wreckages, the unidentified objects, are the result of secret research or experiments.I still believe that there are UFOs.The army said the wreckage was only a fresh weather balloon.However, to anyone who had seen the wreckage, it was clear that whatever this thing was, it was no weather balloon.Good points.Why do you think the five witnesses' statements are put in this order?Can we change the order?I think the paragraphs are organized in time order.Witness A saw a bright object first.Then witness B found some wreckage.Witness C came to collect the wreckage.Witness D saw a spaceship and four aliens.And witness E guarded the trucks with three aliens.I do agree.Besides, this order also helps create suspense.Every witness offered only what they saw, just part of the story.But when I followed them, things became clearer.It's like doing a jigsaw puzzle where every piece is essential for the completion and full understanding of the final result.So, what is the writer's opinion about the Roswell incident?The writer thinks it is a mystery or that there are some doubts about the existence of UFOs.How do you know?The title, nobody knows, means people are unsure of the facts.The introduction says that thousands of people claim they have seen UFOs, which means that UFOs might exist.Talking about the title, nobody knows, is nobody here the same as the one in Nobody Wins?Obviously not.Here, nobody means no one.There is no generally accepted evidence of UFOs or aliens visiting the Earth at all.So, nobody knows what?Can you complete the sentence?I think it is the unsolved mystery that makes the incident one of the most famous stories.In this passage, there is an introduction and a body, but no conclusion.Why not?What kind of conclusion would you add?The article does not want to persuade.It just describes.So, no conclusion is needed.I think the article could conclude with a question about what readers believe based on the reports.Well done.So, we can conclude the article like this.So, what is the truth about the Roswell incident?Perhaps some or all of the witnesses lied.Perhaps a US rocket crashed and people thought it had come from space.Perhaps an alien spaceship really crashed in Roswell.Can you complete the sentences?In today's lesson, we read a report about words of five witnesses.We learned some details about a mysterious Roswell incident.We discussed how a witness account was structured.We tried to tell facts from opinion statements.Maybe we will never know the answer to the mystery, but we've been learning the way to find out the truth.I hope you enjoyed today's lesson.Here is your homework.This is the end of the class.See you next time.
